title: adsorption
intro:
This component describes the adsorption of a chemical to the soil, which among
other things affects how large a fraction can be transported with the water.

sections.name: Freundlich
sections.desc:
M = rho K C ref (C / C ref)m + Theta C. Formula from FOCUS page 93. See also
[Freundlich and Heller, 1939, FOCUS, 2000]
sections.sig:
< Freundlich (m m )
                    (K clay K clay )
                    (K OC K OC )
                    (C ref C ref ) >

attrs.name: m
attrs.doc:
Freundlich parameter (1/n). If not known, FOCUS recommend a value of 0.9
     (page 93). See also [FOCUS, 2000]

attrs.name: K clay
attrs.doc:
Clay dependent distribution parameter. It is multiplied with the soil clay
     fraction to get the clay part of the ’K’ factor. If ’K OC’ is specified, ’K clay’
     defaults to 0.

attrs.name: K OC
attrs.doc:
Humus dependent distribution parameter. It is multiplied with the soil organic
     carbon fraction to get the carbon part of the ’K’ factor. By default, ’K OC’
     is equal to ’K clay’.

attrs.name: C ref
attrs.doc:
Reference concentration for determining the other parameters. According to
     FOCUS, the usual value is 1 mg/L (page 93). See also [FOCUS, 2000]

sections.text:

     Optional parameter

     is equal to ’K clay’.

    C ref : number [g/cm3 ]

sections.text:
Linear sorption with K awi estimated from Equation 11. See also [Guo et al., 2020]
   Used by chemical PFOS Guo adsorption (see 23.25, page 142) , and chemical
PFOA Guo adsorption (see 23.23, page 142) .

     < Guo2020     (K clay K clay )
                   (K OC K OC )
                   (K d K d )
                   (a a )
                   (b b ) >

      K clay: number [cm3 /g]
       Optional parameter
       Clay dependent distribution parameter. It is multiplied with the soil clay
       fraction to get the clay part of the ’K d’ factor. If ’K OC’ is specified, ’K clay’
       defaults to 0.

      K OC : number [cm3 /g]
       Optional parameter
       Humus dependent distribution parameter. It is multiplied with the soil organic
       carbon fraction to get the carbon part of the ’K d’ factor. By default, ’K OC’
       is equal to ’K clay’.

      K d : number [cm3 /g]
       Optional parameter
       Soil dependent distribution parameter. By default, it will be calculated from
       ’K OC’ and ’K clay’.

      a: number [mol/cm3 ]
       Parameter
       Fitting parameter, Eq11.

      b: number (dimensionless)
       Parameter
       Fitting parameter, Eq11.

sections.name: Langmuir
sections.desc: M = rho (my max C) / ((1/K) + C) + Theta C
sections.sig:
< Langmuir (K K )
               (my max clay my max clay )
               (my max OC my max OC ) >

attrs.name: K
attrs.doc: Slope parameter.

attrs.name: my max clay
attrs.doc:
Max adsorption capacity (clay). It is multiplied with the soil clay fraction
       to get the clay part of ’my max’. If ’my max OC’ is specified, ’my max clay’
       defaults to 0.

attrs.name: my max OC
attrs.doc:
Max adsorption capacity (humus). It is multiplied with the soil organic carbon
       fraction to get the carbon part of ’my max’. By default, ’my max OC’ is equal
       to ’my max clay’.

sections.text:
M = rho (my max C) / ((1/K) + C) + Theta C
  < Langmuir (K K )
               (my max clay my max clay )
               (my max OC my max OC ) >

      K : number [cm3 /g]
       Parameter
       Slope parameter.

      my max clay: number [g/g]
       Optional parameter
       Max adsorption capacity (clay). It is multiplied with the soil clay fraction
       to get the clay part of ’my max’. If ’my max OC’ is specified, ’my max clay’
       defaults to 0.

      my max OC : number [g/g]
       Optional parameter
       Max adsorption capacity (humus). It is multiplied with the soil organic carbon
       fraction to get the carbon part of ’my max’. By default, ’my max OC’ is equal
       to ’my max clay’.

attrs.name: C to M
attrs.doc:
Name of function to convert concentration to mass. C to M (C, *extra*) ->
     [g CHEMICAL/cm3 SPACE] total content in soil/water/air.
     where *extra* is the extra parameters specified by ’extra’.

attrs.doc:
Name of the function to convert mass to concentration. M to C (M *extra*)
     -> [g CHEMICAL/cm3 WATER] concentration in soil water.
     where *extra* is the extra parameters specified by ’extra’. By default this
     will use C to M and bisection between 0 and 1.

sections.text:
Adsorption defined in user specified Python module.
  < Python (module module )
               (C to M C to M )
               (M to C M to C )
               (extra extra ...) >
    module: string (see section 4.1.5)
     Parameter
     Python module to find the functions.
    C to M : string (see section 4.1.5)
     Parameter
     Name of function to convert concentration to mass. C to M (C, *extra*) ->
     [g CHEMICAL/cm3 SPACE] total content in soil/water/air.
     where *extra* is the extra parameters specified by ’extra’.
    M to C : string (see section 4.1.5)
     Optional parameter
     Name of the function to convert mass to concentration. M to C (M *extra*)
     -> [g CHEMICAL/cm3 WATER] concentration in soil water.
     where *extra* is the extra parameters specified by ’extra’. By default this
     will use C to M and bisection between 0 and 1.
    extra: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
     Parameter
     Extra input parameters to Python soil function.
     Options include:
     Theta sat [cm3 W/cm3 V]: Saturated water per system volume. Theta [cm3
     W/cm3 V]: Actual water per system volume. rho b [g S/cm3 ]: Soil dry
     bulk density. f OC [g OC/g SOIL]: organic carbon content in soil f clay [g
     clay/g SOIL]: soil clay fraction d50 [um]: median particle diameter area AWI
     [cm2 /cm3 ]: air-water interface area molar mass [g/mol]: molar mass of com-
     pound T [dg C]: soil temperature.

sections.name: air
sections.desc: Henry’s law, fixed ratio between concentration in air and water. See also [?]
sections.sig:
< air (K wa K wa )
           (T ref 25 [dg C])
           (B B ) >

attrs.name: K wa
attrs.doc:
Ratio between concentration in air and in water. K wa = Ca / Cw where Ca
     is mass per volume air, and Cw is mass per volume water.

attrs.name: T ref
attrs.doc: Temperature at which K aw is valid.

attrs.name: B
attrs.doc: Temperature effect coefficient.

sections.text:
Henry’s law, fixed ratio between concentration in air and water. See also [?]
  < air (K wa K wa )
           (T ref 25 [dg C])
           (B B ) >
    K wa: number (dimensionless)
     Parameter
     Ratio between concentration in air and in water. K wa = Ca / Cw where Ca
     is mass per volume air, and Cw is mass per volume water.
    T ref : number [dg C]
     Parameter (default 25)
     Temperature at which K aw is valid.
    B : number [K]
     Parameter
     Temperature effect coefficient.
